content: Ibagwenginbali, baliwiturmar Bab-Dummad-asabin ambikunonibalid. Amar-imbagi nia-saila-Satanás nonibalid.
Bab-Jehová, nia-Satanásʼga sogded: —¿Bia be daniki? Nia-saila-Satanás abin-sogded: —An napneg-naid-ebirdii danikid.

Bab-Jehová ega sogdebalid: —¿An-mai-Job be daksa? ¿Igi gudii be dake? Ar we-napneggine, dule, Jobʼyobid sulid. Jobʼde, angi gwen yoledisulid, an-dobekwaa nanadiid, igar-isganaba nanadisulid. Ar Job gwen ibmar-oakalossuli, an egi yolegega be angi alamaknaigus-inigwele, degine, e-ibe be bela e-ibmar-nikad obelononibar-inigwele, degite, Job amba innikigwadba gudiid, gwen nossulid.
Nia-saila-Satanás, Bab-Jehová-abin sogdebalid: —Ar dule e-san-bendakegala, na e-ibmar-nikad bela ukdaed.
Napira an bega soged, ar be e-dulesunnad sabsur-imakdibe, be daksaled, ar be-asabin begi nue-sabsur ulusaled.
Bab-Jehová, nia-saila-Satanásʼga sogded: —Degir nabirdo. Be Job-naibi-imakega an bega urmaksun, degi-inigwele, mer oburgweddi be oburgo.
Agine, nia-Satanás, Bab-Jehováʼgi banguded. Geb nia-saila-Satanás, Jobʼga boni-dummad-yaabiid uknonikid. Job, bela e-nag-dukuse, degine, nonose-bakale, boni-yaabiid nikunonikid.
Degidbali, Job buru-birgi sigisad. Uka-aimakalile, nog-goagi godidaed.
E-ome ega sogded: —Job, ¿ar bede dule-nuedye nue-sogsunde? ¡Bab-Dummadgi be sabsur-urwe! ¡Be burgwesunna!

Job, e-omega sogded: —Dule-binsaed-satedyob be sunmaked. Ar Bab-Dummad anmarga ibmar-nuegan-ukedi, anmar abingadiid. Degitega, ¿ibiga geg anmar bonigandi abingabarsunna? Anmar, bonigan abingabalirgebed. Weyob Job wiles-inigwele, degite gwen Bab-Dummadgi yolessurgusad, isdar egi sunmaksasurbalid.

Job-e-aimar-warbaagwadi, Job-boniganba-galaitonaid wisgunonimalad. We-dule-warbaagwadi Job-dakdamalaga, degi, ega-gwage-armakega, daredibi na e-yargi noargusmalad. Amar, wemalad: Temán-neggweburgined-Elifaz, Súah-neggweburgined-Bildad, degine, Naamat-neggweburgined-Zofar, wemala Job-e-aimalad.

We-dulemala Job-maidse nonimalad. Bannaba Job-dakarmargua, oemalad, we, doa-dule. Geb nue-dakdemargua, binnasuli bodmalad, bukib-binsaedbali e-mor-yoyoid siir-siir imaksamalad. Degine, nunmak-itogedbali nonogi ukub eosmalad, degi, nonogi buru eosmarbalid.
Deyobi, Job-e-aimar ibagugle (7) mutik-mutik Job-nagaba napagi sigismalad. Ar Job boniba-galitosisoggua, e-aimar gwen Jobʼga sunmakbigussulid.
